title: crepidopteris werneri
intro: Crepidopteris werneri, commonly known as the Chinese maidenhair, is a species of fern native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and sore throat. The health benefits of Crepidopteris werneri are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
